name: FFS_CATALOG_SCHEMA
description: Contains lists of custom fields available for particular catalogs.

columns.name: CATALOG_ID
columns.description: Reference to corresponding FFS_CATALOG the catalog schema belongs to.

columns.name: LABEL
columns.description: Short text identifier if the item field.

columns.name: NAME
columns.description: Name of the item field to be shown in user interface.

columns.name: PROPERTY_LABEL
columns.description: Short text identifier of the property represented by this item field.

columns.name: SEARCHABLE
columns.description: Flag. Marks field as full-text searchable.

columns.name: PREVIEW
columns.description: Flag. Marks field as required to display in offline mode and in preview item card.

columns.name: CATALOG_SCM_MAP_ID
columns.description: Reference to corresponding FFS_CATALOG_SCM_MAP or NULL.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
